scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before machine-washing a named suit at home, [X] prepares its trousers as carefully as the jacket, secures the front hardware, turns the pieces inside out, and separates the relevant items in protective laundry bags.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在家机洗一套明确提到的西装前，[X]会像处理上衣一样仔细准备西裤：先固定前部开合件，再将衣物翻面并分别装进保护洗衣袋。
examples: closing a buttoned trouser front before it enters the wash bag
closing a trouser zipper so exposed teeth or the pull cannot catch another surface
choosing specialist cleaning when the tailored front cannot be protected confidently

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an ordinary mixed machine load, [X] separates heavy jeans from thin clothing, empties pockets, and prepares exposed lower-garment hardware so it will not snag, stretch, or abrade the rest of the wash.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 整理一次普通的混合机洗时，[X]会把厚重牛仔裤与轻薄衣物分开，清空口袋，并处理下装外露的开合件，以免它们勾挂、拉扯或磨损同洗衣物。
examples: closing a zipper before loading so its teeth and pull stay contained
separating heavy denim when hard front hardware could rub delicate pieces
using a protective bag when the fastening cannot be kept away from thin fabrics

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After the groomsmen select army-green suits for a formal wedding, [X] compares ordinary tailoring with evening dress, including how the chosen trousers stay secure and adjust cleanly when a belt may be omitted.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 伴郎团队为正式婚礼选定军绿色西装后，[X]会比较普通西装与晚礼服穿法，包括在可能不系腰带时，所选西裤如何保持稳固并利落调节。
examples: using a button-and-zip front on the selected regular suit trousers
using a concealed hook-and-eye finish when visible hardware should recede
using buckle-based side adjusters on formal trousers designed without a belt

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While discussing what can trigger acid reflux and how serious it may become, [X] identifies pressure from tight belts and waistbands as a preventable factor, making the security-versus-compression tradeoff of everyday lower garments relevant.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在讨论哪些因素会诱发胃酸反流以及后果可能有多严重时，[X]注意到过紧腰带和腰头造成的压力是可避免因素，因此日常下装开合在稳固性与腹部压迫之间的取舍变得重要。
examples: using a pull-on or closure-free waist when minimizing abdominal pressure dominates
using a softly adjustable drawstring rather than a rigid belt after a large meal
avoiding a hard button or buckle position that concentrates pressure at the waist

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a first reformer-Pilates class, [X] chooses fitted leggings or close joggers for raised-leg movements on a sliding carriage and requires a waist that remains low-profile, stable, and free of loose parts around the equipment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 第一次上普拉提核心床课程前，[X]会为抬腿和滑动床动作选择贴身打底裤或收口运动裤，并要求腰部结构低凸、稳定且不会让松散部件靠近器械。
examples: using pull-on construction for a smooth waist while lying and hinging
using no separate closure when any hard component would press into the torso
using a contained low-profile drawstring only when it will not loosen or catch

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping in Ireland for an Italian summer trip, [X] looks for sustainably made shorts that preserve a preference for cool comfort while remaining polished enough for long walking days and a small travel wardrobe.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]在爱尔兰为意大利夏季旅行选购可持续制作的短裤，希望它们既延续偏爱凉爽舒适穿着的习惯，又足够利落，能应对长时间步行和精简旅行衣橱。
examples: using a pull-on waist when heat relief and soft contact matter most
using a drawstring when walking and meals require small fit adjustments
using a button-and-zip front when one pair must also cover a polished stop

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While managing tailbone pain, [X] replaces tight jeans, belts, and thick rear seams with softer trousers or shorts whose waist can stay secure during sitting, cushion use, standing, and short walks without creating a hard pressure point.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在应对尾骨疼痛时，[X]会用更柔软的长裤或短裤替代紧身牛仔裤、腰带和厚重后缝，并要求腰部在久坐、使用坐垫、起身和短距离行走时保持稳固，同时不形成坚硬压点。
examples: using pull-on construction instead of a rigid front during prolonged sitting
using a soft drawstring with only the tension needed for short walks
using closure-free stretch when it can stay stable without a belt or hard fastener

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While toilet-training a daughter who cannot yet speak, [X] watches her nonverbal signals and practices with loose trousers she can lower and raise, treating every additional waist operation as a possible delay before she reaches the potty.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 训练尚不会说话的女儿如厕时，[X]会观察女儿的非语言信号，并让她练习自己拉下和提起宽松长裤；腰部每增加一个操作步骤，都可能延误她及时坐上便盆。
examples: using pull-on trousers for one continuous down-and-up action
using no separate closure during early practice to remove fine-motor steps
postponing buttons, snaps, or a drawstring until the child can operate them independently

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Relocating a long distance mainly by public transport, [X] keeps only two accessible lower garments for transfers, loaded walking, prolonged sitting, and the first night before unpacking, then plans to buy more after arrival.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 主要依靠公共交通进行长途搬迁时，[X]只保留两件随手可取的下装，用于换乘、负重步行、长时间坐车以及尚未拆包的第一晚，并计划抵达后再补购。
examples: using a pull-on waist for the first-night garment when access must be immediate
using a drawstring to readjust around prolonged sitting and changing layers
keeping structured hardware only when it stays comfortable during the loaded test walk

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With only one usable hand and two broken fingers, [X] adapts tools and routines to avoid fine pinching, force, and repeated strain; the same temporary dexterity limit makes one-handed lower-garment fastening a consequential daily constraint.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在只有一只手可用且另有两根手指骨折时，[X]会调整工具和操作流程，以减少精细捏合、用力和反复劳损；同一暂时性灵活度限制也使单手完成下装开合成为重要的日常约束。
examples: using pull-on or closure-free construction when the whole hand can manage one motion
using a large snap or hook-and-loop tab when it can be aligned and released one-handed
avoiding tiny buttons, hook-and-eye hardware, or buckles that require unsupported bilateral pinching

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A beginner turns a garment sketch into the first sample for a planned fashion line, specifying how its lower half opens, testing the fastening during fitting, and revising the pattern before a small production run.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名初学者把服装草图制作成计划中时装系列的首件样衣，明确下半部分如何开合，在试穿中检验开合件，并在小批量生产前修改纸样。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A theme-park period-photo attraction needs costume bottoms that fit a modern size range, change quickly between visitors, hide modern adjustment from the camera, and reset reliably during a busy queue.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一个主题乐园年代照相项目需要下装服装适配现代尺码范围，在游客之间快速更换，把现代调节结构隐藏在镜头之外，并在繁忙排队流程中可靠复位。
